gold_label: No-Go (or optimize) — P-gp efflux gives low Kp,uu; the CNS target won't be engaged
gold_rationale: A high P-gp efflux ratio yields low unbound brain exposure (Kp,uu) regardless of passive permeability; a clean AMES/hERG/solubility profile cannot compensate. For a CNS target this is disqualifying without reducing efflux (No-Go / optimization).
red_flags: ignores P-gp efflux and treats passive permeability as sufficient for CNS exposure
recommends Go because AMES/hERG/solubility are clean

criteria.name: bbb_cns_interpretation
criteria.description: Correctly interprets BBB / CNS exposure for a brain target.

criteria.name: toxicology_interpretation
criteria.description: Correctly interprets toxicology alerts (hERG, AMES, DILI, carcinogenicity).

criteria.name: pk_solubility_reasoning
criteria.description: Reasons about PK, solubility, clearance, and CYP interactions.

criteria.name: chronic_use_safety
criteria.description: Considers chronic-use safety for a long-term PD therapy.

criteria.name: decision_quality
criteria.description: Decision follows from the ADMET/safety profile (does not Go on target relevance alone).

criteria.name: uncertainty
criteria.description: Honest about predictive limits of in silico ADMET.
